name: BreadToPIA
author: Kaon
description:
Remake of Japanese viral game "Suika Game" for PS Vita. Merge 2 (or sometimes 3) bread and evolve it to bigger bread. Complete the order and get scores as high as you can. 
Overclocking is need due to unoptimized code. 
The global score are subject to change without any warning or notification before hand.
